title: NYC Comedy Walking Tour + Live Stand‑Up Show (Drinks Included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This tour is led by a real working NYC comedian who doesn’t just guide the experience — they perform in the live show at the end. You’ll get a fast, funny crash course in the history of stand‑up comedy as you walk through Greenwich Village, then see your guide take the stage alongside other New York comics. It’s the only tour that combines comedy history, insider storytelling, and a live stand‑up performance from your own guide.
